dynamic_line: I appreciate it a lot, getting them somewhere safe.  I hope that's what you did, anyway.  In any case, having the lobby clear is a big help.  Even with the uh, cardboard guy still around, he's a lot easier to handle alone.

responses.text: I do believe we discussed a reward?

concatenate: And so we did."  Smokes reaches under their table, counts out some money, and slides it through a slot in the glass.  "Here's five merch a head for the folks you found a new home for.  We won't forget it
